titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 59: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 59. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number [ⲛⲑ] (top right) is printed in restoration brackets with a bar above and below as the frame; the running title [ⲙⲡ]ⲥⲁϩ has a restored stroke over ⲙ (892–905) and dots under ⲥ and ⲁ. Line 1 is a row of 26 illegible dots (578–1242) that `bands` does not list; its y comes from a zoom. Every dot run on the page was counted from the `dots` x-positions between the bracket positions and checked on the 4× halves; spaces counts the gap after the margin numerals (x ≈ 488) as one extra blank on every line. Most reconcile flags (ll. 16, 17, 23–26, 32, 33) are dot rows standing at the zone centre, which it does not count.
